name: pixelate-text
title: Pixelate Text
description: A title block, a paragraph and a gradient swatch start as coarse blocks of pixels and resolve to sharp, using an SVG pixelate filter (convolve, tile, dilate) whose block size eases down to one pixel.
useWhen: Text or a small layout should resolve from chunky pixels into sharp type, like a low-resolution image loading in.
A retro or digital entrance is wanted without any WebGL.
avoidWhen: The pixelation should wipe across a region of a video: use pixelate-region or grid-pixelate-wipe.
The text is very small: the pixel blocks will eat it.
author: Daniel Petho
